settings.label: Style
settings.help: The overall look: which regions are edited and how strongly.

settings.label: Kind of photo
settings.help: A pack for one kind of photography: what to find, a look and which tools are on. Your own choices win over it.

settings.label: Look
settings.help: Overrides how strong the edit is for this style, for example punchy or soft.

settings.label: Strength
settings.help: How much of the edit is applied: below 1 is subtler, above 1 is stronger.

settings.label: Colour grade
settings.help: A colour mood such as cool blue or warm gold. Auto picks one from your words, off adds none.

settings.label: Colour grade strength
settings.help: How strongly the colour grade tints the photo. 0 is none, 1 is the full grade.

settings.label: Reference photo
settings.help: A photo whose colours and tones the result should move toward.

settings.label: Reference strength
settings.help: How closely to follow the reference photo. 0 ignores it, 1 matches it fully.

settings.label: Grain
settings.help: Film grain on the finished photo, 0 to 100. Empty uses the look's own; 25 is light, 100 is heavy.

settings.label: Grain size
settings.help: How coarse the grain is. 1 is fine, 2 is twice as coarse. It follows the size of the export.

settings.label: LUT file
settings.help: A .cube colour filter file laid over the finished photo. Empty uses none.

settings.label: LUT strength
settings.help: How much of the LUT file is blended in, 0 to 100.

settings.label: Intent
settings.help: A few words about the mood you want, such as warm sunset or moody. It is read on your computer.

settings.label: Edit instructions
settings.help: Plain-language changes to parts of the photo, for example brighten the jacket.

settings.label: Understand free text on this computer
settings.help: A small model on this Mac reads edit instructions the word list does not know. Auto uses it when Ollama is running.

settings.label: Local model
settings.help: The Ollama model that reads instructions.

settings.label: Local model address
settings.help: Where Ollama listens on this computer.

settings.label: Local model time limit (s)
settings.help: How long to wait for the local model before the instruction counts as not understood.

settings.label: Vignette and sky gradient
settings.help: Allows gentle darkened edges and sky gradients that guide the eye to the subject.

settings.label: Vignette
settings.help: Darkens the edges slightly. Turn off for an even frame.

settings.label: Sharpen
settings.help: Adds a little final sharpening to the export.

settings.label: Keep blown highlights white
settings.help: Keeps areas that were pure white in the original from turning grey after the edit.

settings.label: Glow where the sun is
settings.help: Adds a soft warm glow around the sun or a bright light when the photo has a clear one.

settings.label: Fill gaps at the frame edge
settings.help: Extends a marked area that stops just short of the edge of the picture to the edge, so no thin unedited rim is left.

settings.label: Set black and white point
settings.help: Stretches the tones so the darkest parts are properly black and the brightest properly white.

settings.label: Reduce noise
settings.help: Smooths grain in dark, high-ISO photos while keeping edges.

settings.label: Night sky
settings.help: Night photos stay dark and lose a town's glow and stuck pixels; noise reduction and sharpening spare the stars.

settings.label: Clean backdrop
settings.help: Evens out a light background and takes it to a clean white. Nothing is cut out; a photo without a light background is left alone.

settings.label: Straighten
settings.help: Turns the photo so that a clear waterline or horizon is level, at most 5 degrees. The edges are cut.

settings.label: Neutral spot
settings.help: A spot that is grey or white, X and Y as shares of the frame from the top left. The white balance makes it neutral.

settings.label: White balance
settings.help: Temp and tint for every photo, in place of the rules' own. A neutral spot measured once gives these two numbers.

settings.label: Remove colour fringes
settings.help: Lines up the red and blue parts of the picture with the green to remove colour fringes toward the corners.

settings.label: Consistency
settings.help: Brightness evens out the shoot; bursts evens frames of one scene; timelapse evens flicker between frames in order.

settings.label: Same white balance
settings.help: Brings the photos of a group to one white balance, so the same product keeps the same colour from photo to photo.

settings.label: Colour report
settings.help: After the run, shows how far the colour of the subject differs inside each group of photos.

settings.label: File format
settings.help: The file type of the finished photos.

settings.label: Longest side (pixels)
settings.help: Shrinks the export so its longest side is this many pixels. Empty keeps full size.

settings.label: File name
settings.help: Name of each exported file without the ending. Use {stem} for the original name, {style} and {n}.

settings.label: Subfolder
settings.help: Puts the exports in a subfolder of the output folder. Empty uses the output folder itself.

settings.label: Export preset
settings.help: A saved bundle of output settings, such as web or print.

settings.label: Quality
settings.help: Picture quality of JPEG and WebP files. Higher is sharper and bigger.

settings.label: Photo information
settings.help: What camera data stays in the export: keep all, share without location and serial numbers, or none.

settings.label: Crop to shape
settings.help: Crops the export to a shape such as 4:5 or 1:1, placed on the subject. Empty keeps the photo's own shape.

settings.label: Watermark text
settings.help: One line of text laid over a corner of the export. Set in an export preset. Empty: no mark.

settings.label: Watermark logo
settings.help: The file name of a PNG in your profile folder, laid beside the watermark text. Empty: no logo.

settings.label: Watermark corner
settings.help: The corner of the export the watermark sits in.

settings.label: Watermark size
settings.help: Height of the watermark in percent of the export's shorter side, 1 to 20.

settings.label: Watermark opacity
settings.help: How solid the watermark is, from 0.1 (faint) to 1 (solid).

settings.label: Check before sharing
settings.help: Lists photos that show plates, screens, documents, people or file metadata. It looks only for what is on its list. It changes no picture.

settings.label: Keep a history of your edits
settings.help: One line per exported photo in your profile: what you changed, no picture, no file name. It never leaves this computer.

settings.label: RAW method
settings.help: How RAW files are brightened when opened. None keeps the standard camera-style result.

settings.label: Largest brightening (stops)
settings.help: The most a RAW photo may be brightened when it is opened.

settings.label: Allowed white area
settings.help: The share of the photo that may turn pure white while brightening a RAW file.

settings.label: Target brightness
settings.help: The middle brightness a RAW photo is brightened toward in the tone target method.

settings.label: Brightening without preview (stops)
settings.help: How much to brighten a RAW file that has no camera preview to compare with.

settings.label: Recover blown highlights
settings.help: Brings back the tones a RAW file holds in snow and sky that the normal decode turns flat white. RAW files only; a little slower.

settings.label: Region finder
settings.help: How parts of the photo such as sky or skin are found. Stub finds none and needs no download.

settings.label: Regions to edit
settings.help: Names of the parts to find and edit, such as sky or water. Empty list turns region editing off.

settings.label: Region set
settings.help: A ready-made list of regions, such as landscape or wedding. It replaces the style's own list.

settings.label: Edit method
settings.help: Rules is the built-in method. LLM asks your AI assistant. Learned uses a model you trained.

settings.label: Allow cloud assistant
settings.help: Gives permission to send a small preview and numbers, never the full photo, to your AI provider.

settings.label: Assistant role
settings.help: Refine adjusts the built-in edit; propose lets the assistant suggest the edit itself.

settings.label: Assistant model
settings.help: The name of the AI model to ask.

settings.label: Assistant variation
settings.help: 0 gives the same answer each time; higher values vary more.

settings.label: Let the assistant read instructions
settings.help: Lets the assistant turn your edit instructions into changes when the built-in reader cannot.

settings.label: Preview size (pixels)
settings.help: The longest side of the small preview sent to the assistant.

settings.label: Most assistant calls
settings.help: Stops asking the assistant after this many photos. 0 means no limit.

settings.label: Spending limit (USD)
settings.help: Stops asking the assistant once a run has cost this much. 0 means no limit.

settings.label: Price per million input tokens (USD)
settings.help: What your model charges for what it reads. Used only to apply the spending limit.

settings.label: Price per million output tokens (USD)
settings.help: What your model charges for what it writes. Used only to apply the spending limit.

settings.label: Trained model file
settings.help: The model you trained, used when the edit method is learned.

settings.label: Parallel photos
settings.help: How many photos are edited at the same time. 0 picks a sensible number for your computer.

settings.label: Threads per photo
settings.help: How many processor threads one photo may use. 0 uses all of them.

settings.label: Analysis size (pixels)
settings.help: The size the photo is shrunk to for analysis. Smaller is faster, larger is more exact.

settings.label: Processor
settings.help: Which processor finds regions: auto, cpu, or a graphics card name such as cuda or mps.

settings.label: Remember regions
settings.help: Saves the found regions so that editing the same photos again is much faster.
